description: This file contains shell script functions for managing push operations to GitHub repositories, including resolving repository URLs, pushing to forks via GraphQL, verifying pull request branches, setting up remotes, and handling push retries with fallbacks. It is part of automation tooling for GitHub PR management and repository updates.

methods.name: resolve_head_push_url
methods.description: Resolves the push URL for the PR's source repository, either using owner/repo info or the repository URL from environment variables.

methods.name: graphql_push_to_fork
methods.description: Pushes commits to a fork via GitHub GraphQL API, creating a commit on a branch with specified file changes.

methods.name: resolve_head_push_url_https
methods.description: Resolves the HTTPS URL for the PR's source repository.

methods.name: verify_pr_head_branch_matches_expected
methods.description: Verifies the current PR head branch matches the expected branch name.

methods.name: setup_prhead_remote
methods.description: Sets up the 'prhead' remote for pushing to the PR source repository.

methods.name: resolve_prhead_remote_sha
methods.description: Resolves the SHA of the remote branch for the PR source, falling back if necessary.

methods.name: push_prep_head_to_pr_branch
methods.description: Handles pushing the prepared head to the PR branch, with retries and fallbacks, updating environment variables.
